messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ded-pool node-health failed for pool=ded-ekg-1 node=gpu-527 (ECC_ERRORS_HIGH). Paging on-call SRE team.

alex_sre: got the page, looking. seeing a spike in ECC errors and kernel OOMs on gpu-527. telemetry shows thermal excursions ~15:12 UTC.

jamie_eng_runtime: pinging in — logs from runtime show repeated nvml errors + process churn for tenant ekg-payments. putting tentative impact: tenant-level throttles kicked, some in-flight requests retried.

priya_soleng: FYI this is a dedicated pool for EKGCorp (VPC, critical payments). Need to confirm customer-visible impact before we escalate externally.

alex_sre: I'm going to cordon+drain node now to stop new allocations. command: ```redwoodctl node cordon gpu-527 --pool ded-ekg-1 && redwoodctl pool drain --pool ded-ekg-1 --node gpu-527 --grace 30s --force```

alex_sre: output snippet: ```Cordoned node gpu-527
Evicting 12 pods (2 pinned to tenant ekg-payments)
Eviction succeeded for 10 pods, 2 pods remained due to local-storage lock
Drain timed out after 30s for 2 pods; marking node for replacement
```

hardware-ops: received request to replace gpu-527. ETA for hardware swap in on-prem rack is ~3.5 hours (need spare GPU and cold-swap window). Opening HW ticket HW-8932.

liu_eng: runtime note — because of pinned tenant pods we should trigger tenant-level fallback to backup pool to avoid request failures. Proposing `redwoodctl routing set --tenant ekg-payments --pool ded-ekg-2 --priority 90 --grace-period 60s`.

marta_am: @ekg_oncall, we should send a quick notification: "We're seeing degraded performance in your dedicated pool; we're draining an affected node and routing traffic to your backup capacity. We'll follow up with ETA for hardware replacement." Approve?

ekg_oncall: confirmed, please include that no data was lost and requests may see retries. customer already noticing some 5xxs. keep me in loop.

priya_soleng: drafting message for customer now. will include timeline, mitigation, and next steps.

ops_manager: alex, set incident severity to Sev2 and create an incident ticket in JIRA (RDW-INC-2024-432). Assign owners for mitigation + communication.

alex_sre: done — ticket RDW-INC-2024-432 created. ownership: alex_sre (ops lead), jamie_eng_runtime (runtime), hardware-ops (hw swap), priya_soleng (customer comms).

jamie_eng_runtime: executing routing change to fallback pool now. command: ```redwoodctl routing set --tenant ekg-payments --pool ded-ekg-2 --priority 90 --grace-period 45s && redwoodctl cache flush --tenant ekg-payments --scope prefix```

deploy-bot: deploy/route-change started by jamie_eng_runtime at 1999994600. CI checks passed.

deploy-bot: deploy/route-change finished successfully. New route active on 10 nodes in ded-ekg-2.

liu_eng: monitoring shows 95th latency return to normal for ekg-payments after route switch. error rate falling from ~8% -> ~0.7%. Looks good but keep watch for retries and duplicate downstream side effects.

marta_am: customer msg sent at 1999994702 — "We have routed traffic to backup capacity; some retries may have occurred. Our team is working on replacing the affected hardware and will share ETA updates."

ekg_oncall: customer replied: thanks, appreciate quick action. asking whether there will be billing impact for routing to backup pool.

priya_soleng: noted. finance/AMs to confirm billing policy for short-term fallback consumption; will follow up by EOD.

alex_sre: long-term steps: mark node for decommission, reprovision new host, run memtest+nvdiag, and reprovision tenant workload with zero-downtime where possible. Will also record diagnostic bundle: ```/opt/redwood/bin/collect-diagnostics --node gpu-527 --output /tmp/gpu-527-diag.tar.gz```

hardware-ops: spare GPU allocated, target swap window scheduled at 1999997200 UTC. HW engineer will be onsite and will run vendor diagnostics post-swap.

jamie_eng_runtime: temporary mitigation checklist complete: 1) drained node 2) routed tenant 3) flushed prefix cache 4) monitored duplicate requests. Next: watch KV cache warm-up for ekg-payments to avoid cold-start latency.

ops_manager: please start a customer-impact timeline in the incident ticket and mark communications log. Also add a postmortem owner for root-cause and remediation (alex_sre).

priya_soleng: adding note: customer asked for SLA credit assessment if errors exceed threshold. capturing action item for finance to review.

alex_sre: will follow up after HW swap and rejoin for verification. If anything degrades, escalate to hotpatch fallback (cpu-only lane) as last resort.

incident-bot: Incident RDW-INC-2024-432 updated: status=mitigated impact=partial-routing fallback=ded-ekg-2 owners=[alex_sre,jamie_eng_runtime,hardware-ops,priya_soleng].

marta_am: thanks team. quick, surgical run. keep monitoring for the next 4 hours and then we can close the on-call handoff. :thumbsup:"
